english.title: Ride a pedal cycle on a road and fail to comply with the indication given by a traffic sign
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), whilst propelling a pedal cycle, failed to comply with the indication given by a traffic sign to which section 36 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 applied, namely

(A)_[a give way sign,]_
(B)_[a directional arrow sign,]_
(C)_[a roundabout sign,]_
(D)_[a vehicle priority sign,]_
(E)_[a bus or tram route sign,]_
(F)_[a manually operated stop sign,]_
(G)_[a convoy escort with 'no overtaking' sign,]_
(H)_[a stop road works sign,]_
(I)_[a mobile road works directional sign,]_
(J)_[give way road markings,]_
(K)_[bus stop road markings,]_
(L)_[solid white lines and chevrons dividing traffic lanes on a length of carriageway or slip road,]_
(M)_[box junction road markings,]_
(N)_[a stop sign,]_
(O)_[double white line road markings,]_
(P)_[a red light traffic sign,]_
(Q)_[light signals for the control of road traffic at a level crossing,]_
(R)_[light signals for the control of road traffic at a swing or lifting bridge,]_
(S)_[light signals for the control of road traffic at an airfield,]_
(T)_[light signals for the control of road traffic in the vicinity of premises used regularly by fire and rescue authority, police or ambulance vehicles,]_
(U)_[a school crossing patrol stop sign,]_
(V)_[road markings delineating a pedestrian crossing,]_
(W)_[a no entry sign,]_

lawfully placed on or near a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 36(1) of the Road Traffic Act 1988, the Traffic Signs Regulations and General Directions 2016 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) See H19031, H19028 and H19029 for other similar wordings relating to other types of conveyance.
(ii) No Entry signs
The Traffic Signs Regulations and General Directions 2016, resulted in 'No Entry' signs being no longer included as section 36 road traffic signs. The Traffic Signs (Amendment England and Wales) Regulations and General Directions 2017 have rectified the situation and from 13th December 2017 'No Entry' signs are again classed as section 36 road traffic signs.
